qualifications: Stacked on the three ActiveJob runtime fixes. Baseline is that frozen runtime, not an older main.

The baseline native installation is reused from an earlier measurement of the identical binary and source; hashes and revisions are checked. The candidate native installation is fresh for its exact binary.
Ordinary O2 and normal GC for corpus, Ruby core, Rails acceptance and RSS. GC32 only in the small corpus959 boundary matrix.
Core outcomes and per-case inventories are retained, including any pre-existing failures or timeouts. A complete file need not be all passing.
Rails uses jobs2, per-file-family 600-second/2-GiB bounds and seed12345. Incomplete baseline exceptions_test retains its 33 missing cases.
RSS samples are three alternating pairs per engine; report ranges and medians without claiming a stable improvement.
Instruction counts include startup: medians of three alternating whole-process pairs, each executing 5000 queries. No per-operation or zero-cost claim.
Final component-wide sweeps are separate from these focused controls.
